newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close lower as blue chips lose.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close lower as blue chips lose.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed lower amid a continued selling pressure by investors seeking cash to pay off bank loans before the financial year ends on June 30, brokers said.
"There is large selling pressure on blue-chips in financial and industrial sectors in a typical year-end phenomenon," said one broker.
The benchmark index of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) had lost 13.71 points or 1.24 percent at 1,091.7 on a turnover of 52.2 million taka. The losers led gainers 98 to 27.

Delta Life Insurance Co led the losers shedding 81.76 taka per share at 1,065.71 ahead of its annual general meeting on Tuesday. Monno Ceramics fell 39.49 at 815.42 after the company faced shut down following a labour unrest.
But share prices of some companies including United Leasing, Apex Foods and Maq Paper Industries, which fell over the past several sessions, recovered their loses marginally.
